name: Palo Alto (United States)
description: Vertical tricolour of navy blue, white and green, the white charged with a yellow ring bearing a tree and the words PALO ALTO, INCORPORATED APRIL 16, 1894, CALIFORNIA.
history: Palo Alto is a charter city in northwestern Santa Clara County, California; the tree is the redwood El Palo Alto for which the city is named.

features.role: ring with a tree and the words PALO ALTO INCORPORATED APRIL 16, 1894
